namespace PubAC02
def WeakModInv (m a x : Nat) : Prop := m > 1 → (a * x) % m ≤ m
def zeroInv (_m _a : Nat) : Nat := 0
def checkModInv (m a x : Nat) : Bool := (m > 1) && ((a * x) % m == 1)
theorem zeroInv_meets_weak (m a : Nat) : WeakModInv m a (zeroInv m a) := by sorry
theorem checkModInv_sound (m a x : Nat) (h : checkModInv m a x = true) : m > 1 ∧ (a * x) % m = 1 := by sorry
theorem checkModInv_witness : checkModInv 7 3 5 = true := by sorry
end PubAC02
